metadata.name: Fogbound
metadata.author: Tile Trigger
metadata.description: Trench warfare in the fog: two trench networks dug into a muddy field, ground mist pooling in every trench, crater and camp, and a ruined chapel on the ridge between them standing clear above it all. In the trench you see a shape three metres ahead and can't tell whose it is; climb a fire step and your head is up in clear air, in sight of the ridge. The flags sit in roofed dugouts with one way in; guard towers with machine guns watch over each camp.
